title: 海底光纜通訊系統
summary: 以海底鏈路、放大器雜訊與維修可靠性串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect submarine links, amplifier noise and repair reliability through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: Wet plant 邊界：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Wet-plant boundaries: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「Wet plant 邊界」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For wet-plant boundaries, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「Wet plant 邊界」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：海中纖、放大器與分支單元和岸端設備責任不同。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：只改 span 長度，觀察段數與雜訊取捨。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「纜路段數」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around wet-plant boundaries, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Submerged fibers, amplifiers and branches differ from terminal responsibilities. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Vary span length and compare span-count/noise tradeoffs. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat span counts as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 只改 span 長度，觀察段數與雜訊取捨。 比較「Wet plant 邊界」與「纜路段數」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Vary span length and compare span-count/noise tradeoffs. Compare whether evidence for wet-plant boundaries and span counts supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 光放大器恢復功率便完全消除先前雜訊。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: An optical amplifier restores power and removes all prior noise. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「Wet plant 邊界」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 海中纖、放大器與分支單元和岸端設備責任不同。
knowledge.textEn: Submerged fibers, amplifiers and branches differ from terminal responsibilities.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「纜路段數」：纜長與段長決定放大段數，不直接等於可靠性。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「Wet plant 邊界」已通過。

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想 6000 km 路線以 80 km 段切分，共 75 段；若每段損耗 16 dB，不能直接把 1200 dB 當作端到端淨損耗，因中間有放大且逐段累加雜訊。
knowledge.textEn: A hypothetical 6000 km route at 80 km per span has 75 spans; 75×16=1200 dB is not net end-to-end loss when intermediate amplification restores signal and adds noise.
